title.narrative: O3: Comprehensive Sexuality Education in Malawi Phase II

description.narrative: This project is designed to deliver good quality CSE that empowers adolescents and young people in Malawi and builds agency while developing the skills, knowledge, attitudes and competencies required for preventing HIV, reducing early and unintended pregnancies, and eliminating gender-based violence. This project seeks to build on young people’s individual capacity of making safer choices while strengthening the linkages between information (CSE) and sexual and reproductive health services provision. As a follow-on from Phase I (MWI-18/0014), the project aims to continue the work on CSE targeting primary education, and will focus on competency building for teachers, capacity building for government at all levels, continued support towards the finalisation of the Life Skills curriculum and its implementation, policy development and advocacy for CSE in Malawi.
